sourceContext: User-authorized non-visual development and validation after supervised Quick Entry QA
objective: Harden and advance TeamGest locally through non-visual inspection, validation and safe defect correction within the existing hours-first architecture.
why: Continue authorized TeamGest development without relying on blocked autonomous browser QA, preserving existing work and local-first boundaries.
scope: inspect Settings, storage, data safety and local persistence
detect functional, typing, import, route and dependency defects
run lint, typecheck, build and available deterministic tests
add focused unit tests only when required by a reproducible defect
fix reproducible local defects inside evaluated TeamGest modules
persist official Executor reports, Reviewer decisions and durable checkpoints
continue the authorized non-visual backlog when gates pass
outOfScope: visual QA or CUA from Executor
secrets, real data, external services or new costs
acceptanceCriteria: Settings, storage, data-safety and persistence boundaries are inspected with evidence
lint, typecheck, build and available deterministic tests pass or have documented reproducible blockers
reproducible defects in evaluated modules are fixed with focused regression coverage where appropriate
no P0, P1 or blocking P2 finding remains in the evaluated non-visual scope
Reviewer independently verifies the real Executor evidence
a durable checkpoint records the completed task and final Git status
allowedAutonomy: modify only scoped TeamGest source, tests and documentation
run local lint, typecheck, build and deterministic tests
create local commits or checkpoints without push
write official reports and evidence through ORCHESTOR
allowedActions: write scoped documentation and durable local evidence
forbiddenActions: run visual QA or CUA from Executor
modify Costa Clean, Ridaos Print or ORCHESTOR
requiredApprovals: additional approval for any action outside this scope
stopConditions: P0, P1 or blocking security finding
required tool or test boundary unavailable
verificationRequirements: verify Git identity, branch, HEAD, dirty status and scoped diff
run npm run build with typecheck
inspect Settings, storage, data-safety and persistence paths
run independent Reviewer on durable Executor evidence
record durable checkpoint and final Git status
